n. (-नं)
The last month of uterine gestation.
E.
वि before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्, and अण् added.

The banner or emblem of INDRA.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A flag, a banner, an ensign.
2 A small tree, (Sesbana Ægyptiaca.)
3 Another tree, (Premna spinosa, &c.)
4 A kind of garland.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, भृञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A flag-bearer.
f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Sesbana Ægyptiaca.)
2 A flag, a banner.
E.
वैजयन्ती a flag, with ठक् aff., or कन् pleonasm, fem. form.

m. (-यिः)
The third Cakravartī or emperor according to the Jainas.
E.
विजया a proper name, and इञ् patronymic aff.

n. (-त्यं)
1 Difference or deviation from ordinary character or conduct.
2 Exclusion from caste.
3 Difference of caste or species.
4 Looseness, wantonness.
E.
वि before जाति species, &c. ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Seminal, relating to seed or origin.
n. (-कं)
1 Cause, origin, motive.

The spiritual cause of existence, soul, spirit.
m. (-कः)
A young shoot or sprout.
E.
वीज seed, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Skilful, clever, dexterous, proficient.
E.
विज्ञान knowledge, science, aff. ठक्.
